name: Onishi Emiri
source:
There is nothing more important to an Onishi than her duty.

Serious, immaculate, dignified, Emiri was groomed since she was a child to take over the Onishi household. As the town of Komachi was built on traditions Emiri became one of their figureheads the moment she inherited her family's shrine. With her no-nonsense attitude and ice cold glare, she is deemed to be unapproachable by her peers. The elder of the Onishi twins, she tends to keep a close eye on her sister, in spite of their rocky relationship.

Is her stalwart stance truly backed by a frozen heart, or is it a wall to keep the hurt at bay? Or is there something even deeper that she is trying to hide? The answer is for you to find.
